landing.heroTitle: One platform for every agricultural role
landing.heroDescription: Bringing farmers, agro-dealers, organic fertilizer producers, officers, and administrators together. Sign in to access the workspace for your role and manage your part of the fertilizer journey.
landing.featuresDescription: Each role has a dedicated dashboard, with the tools and information needed for its responsibilities. Product listings and day-to-day tasks belong in your workspace.
landing.farmerDescription: Apply for fertilizer subsidies, follow your applications, and manage your credits and orders.
landing.officerDescription: Review farmer applications, coordinate handovers, and follow distribution across your area.
landing.governmentDescription: Oversee imports, stock, officer assignments, fertilizer distribution, and subsidy credits.
landing.systemDescription: Manage users, service areas, wallets, and audit records from an administration workspace.
landing.dealerDescription: Maintain product listings, handle incoming orders, and manage credit redemption requests.
landing.producerDescription: Manage your organic fertilizer listings, customer orders, and settlements in one place.
landing.marketDescription: Find product details and purchasing tools inside the workspace available to your role.
landing.languageDescription: Explore the platform in your preferred language and learn where your role fits in.
landing.testimonialsDescription: Hear how farmers, dealers, and officers approach fertilizer access and distribution with BhumiSaara.
landing.farmerQuote: With the digital passbook, I know exactly when my fertilizer quota is ready. No more waiting in long lines wondering if supplies have arrived at the center.
landing.dealerQuote: The dealer portal automatically syncs our inventory with the national grid. It has completely eliminated the paperwork we used to struggle with during distribution season.
landing.officerQuote: Blockchain verification means we have 100% accurate data on where the fertilizer went. Auditing the supply chain is now instant and fully transparent.
